title: In multiple locations, there is a possible memory corruption due to a use-after-free. (CVE-2026-58984)
description: CVE-2026-58984 is a use-after-free vulnerability present in multiple locations that can cause memory corruption. It allows local attackers to escalate privileges without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.4.
